_about: Which lifts the operators mean by 'upper mountain' / 'lower mountain'. Data, not code: not yet read by the parser. Source: data/raw/lifts/palisades_lifts_2026-11-07.md (last section), read from the operators' own posts 2018-19 to 2025-26; where AI tools disagreed, the posts won. Names are the parser's canonical lift names.

notes.Funitel: Sometimes runs alone while the rest of upper is held ('Funitel for Mountain Run only'). An exception, not a different group.
notes.Base to Base Gondola: Held together with the upper lifts in 2024-25; the file lists it as upper but this is the thinnest evidence of the group.
notes.Broken Arrow: MODERATE confidence. Held in the same wind-hold list as Bailey's Beach, Mountain Meadow, Belmont and others (2018-19); a 2022-23 post lists it on patrol hold beside 'all other upper mountain lifts'. An AI answer said lower-to-mid; the posts do not support that.
notes.Gold Coast: Parser has one 'Gold Coast' lift. The resort lists Gold Coast Express (6HSD, 935 m) and the Funitel (Gold Coast Funitel) separately. Which one a post means is unchecked.

notes.Olympic Lady: LOWER. Listed open beside KT-22, Exhibition, Red Dog and Resort Chair while all upper lifts are on wind hold (2022-23, 2025-26). It does hold in very strong wind but is named apart from the upper group.
notes.First Venture: Opens with the lower lifts (operators' posts).
notes.Kaya Carpet: 'The carpets' open with the lower lifts; carpet membership is inferred from that phrase.

alpine._note: Operators rarely say 'upper mountain' at Alpine; they name lifts. Evidence is thin. No upper/lower split is claimed. Lifts below are the ones the file names.
alpine.ALL_ALPINE: 'all aerial lifts at Alpine' / 'all lifts at Alpine' is a site-wide scope, handled separately by the parser.

meadow_vs_mountain_meadow.Mountain Meadow: High Camp, Palisades side, 3-seat fixed, 850 m. Upper group.
meadow_vs_mountain_meadow.Alpine Meadow: The file's 'Meadow': Alpine, Scott/Lakeview area next to Subway, 2-seat fixed, 366 m. NOT in the Palisades groups.
meadow_vs_mountain_meadow.parser_status: SEPARATED (scripts/parse_posts.py, find_lifts). A bare 'Meadow' is Alpine Meadow when its own span names Alpine-only lifts (or says Alpine), else when the whole post does and names no Palisades-only lift; 'Mountain/Mtn Meadow' is always Mountain Meadow. Bare 'Meadow' in a post with no Alpine signal stays Mountain Meadow.

not_in_the_2026_lifts_file.note: Legacy names appear in 2018-2021 posts (Squaw Valley era). The four beginner lifts have 0 posts except 'boomer' (5, meaning unchecked).

likely_renames_UNVERIFIED._note: Read off the event counts by winter (a name vanishes the winter another appears). Not applied anywhere: per-lift analysis keeps the names as posted. Verify before merging.
likely_renames_UNVERIFIED.Squaw Creek -> Wa She Shu: Squaw Creek posts run 2018-19 to 2020-21; Wa She Shu first appears 2021-22.
likely_renames_UNVERIFIED.Squaw One -> Resort Chair: Squaw One posts run 2018-19 to 2020-21; Resort Chair first appears 2021-22.
likely_renames_UNVERIFIED.Tucker Carpet -> Kaya Carpet: Tucker 2018-19 to 2019-20; Kaya from 2020-21. Weakest of the three.

first_seen_by_winter.note: Emigrant has no events in 2021-22 and Silverado none in 2019-20 and 2025-26.
